aboutMe.heading: About me
description: I'm a software engineer who loves building things that are fast, scalable, and actually enjoyable to use. Whether it's designing a solid backend architecture, optimizing frontend performance, or making sure everything runs smoothly in production, I like solving problems that make an impact. I work across the stack, using tools like TypeScript, React, Node, and cloud services to build apps that are both powerful and maintainable.

I'm always looking for ways to make code cleaner, systems more efficient, and developer workflows smoother. Whether it's tweaking API performance, figuring out a better way to handle data, or just geeking out over a new tool, I enjoy the process of refining and improving how things work. Most of all, I love building products that feel great to use and help people get things done.
